summary.en: The Detective Boys are wandering the streets in the residential area around Professor Agasa's house, worrying about Haibara, who has gone missing since she went shopping several hours ago. At first, Genta, Mitsuhiko, and Ayumi are wondering whether Haibara has become the victim of a traffic accident, but then Conan finds a cat's shawl lying on the street. Seeing this, he remembers how he, Haibara and the Professor recently met a friendly young woman named Mitsuru Higaki, along with her pet cat Chiro, who wore the shawl, and her Indian Star Tortoise.
